Procurement situation: Acquiring calibrated laboratory instruments under a one-step supplier offer.

Your option payoffs (points):
- Unit price (price): 80 per unit [price_80] = 44 points; 90 per unit [price_90] = 34 points; 100 per unit [price_100] = 24 points
- Delivery schedule (delivery): Standard delivery [standard] = 8 points; Fast delivery [fast] = 23 points; Immediate delivery [immediate] = 33 points
- Warranty (warranty): Basic warranty [basic] = 6 points; Annual service warranty [annual] = 16 points; Extended warranty [extended] = 26 points
- Payment terms (payment): Net 30 [net_30] = 12 points; Net 60 [net_60] = 7 points; Upfront payment [upfront] = 2 points

Your reservation value: 36 points.
Your disagreement payoff: 26 points.
Supplier standing package: price=price_90, delivery=fast, warranty=basic, payment=net_60
Supplier stated priorities: Warranty scope; Fast installation
Hard constraints (not negotiable preferences):
- Immediate delivery cannot be combined with net 60 payment.

Return either a complete offer or an acceptance of the standing package.
For an acceptance, repeat the standing package exactly.
Use exactly these top-level JSON fields: decision, package.
The package keys are price, delivery, warranty, and payment. Do not add any other fields.
